0.2.3.notes:
Experimental macOS and Linux prototype release, version 0.2.3.

Prototype software. Use at your own risk. Stability and backward compatibility are not guaranteed. Use copies of your data and projects.

This patch speeds up MET example setup by avoiding a repeated deep content audit after downloading the verified release archive. Download integrity and safe extraction checks remain in place. It also renders semantic icons directly from the bundled SVGs to prevent blank icons on first launch. No project-format change is introduced.

Both Mac DMGs are Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled. Packaged self-tests passed on all four build platforms, and signed Mac runtime tests passed on Apple Silicon and under Rosetta. Linux packages were built and self-tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Fresh manual installation checks on Intel hardware and Linux, and broader Linux distribution support, remain unverified for this version.

Quit EIDORA before installing and back up existing projects. On macOS, open the DMG and drag EIDORA into Applications. On Linux, make the AppImage executable or install the DEB with your package manager.

Windows 0.2.3 is prepared separately for installed testing before Microsoft Store submission. It is not included in these public downloads.

Application build source: a981da729420d432017305ab6d40248e5be53a7d.

linux-x86_64.requirements: Linux x64; built and self-tested on Ubuntu 24.04

0.2.4.notes:
Experimental macOS, Linux, and Windows prototype release, version 0.2.4.

Prototype software. Use at your own risk. Stability and backward compatibility are not guaranteed. Use copies of your data and projects.

This patch fixes automatic thumbnail creation after image/video embedding, preserves thumbnail aspect ratio independently of model preprocessing, and corrects upside-down portrait video thumbnails. It also fixes UMAP runtime permissions in signed Mac applications, Discovery shutdown, Windows welcome-tour positioning, and Discovery filter/snapshot footer alignment. Project formats and dependency pins are unchanged.

Both Mac DMGs are Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled. Packaged self-tests passed on all four build platforms. Signed Mac runtime checks passed on Apple Silicon and under Rosetta, including a real UMAP projection. Linux packages were built and self-tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Fresh manual installation checks on Intel hardware and Linux, and broader Linux distribution support, remain unverified for this experimental version.

Quit EIDORA before installing and back up existing projects. On macOS, open the DMG and drag EIDORA into Applications. On Linux, make the AppImage executable or install the DEB with your package manager.

Windows 0.2.4 is available through Microsoft Store (package version 1.2.4.0). Microsoft manages installation and updates. Separate manual installed-Windows validation and WACK results have not been recorded here.

Application build source: bd86a53b8f88a905036ef8e4f333777232981d81.

linux-x86_64.requirements: Linux x64; built and self-tested on Ubuntu 24.04
